verdict.rationale: Datalab's API and SDK cover the document capabilities shown in the UI: conversion, structured extraction, segmentation, form filling, track changes, pipelines, file management and agent processors. A published OpenAPI 3.1 spec backs this up. But no documentation claims API–UI parity, and account functions such as enabling 2FA are documented only through the dashboard. missing for 10: explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of account/team/security settings (e.g., 2FA, team policies), independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Datalab Python SDK provides a simple interface for document conversion, pipelines, structured extraction, form filling, and file management.
Create a DOCX document from markdown with track changes support.
Segment a document into sections using a schema. Returns page ranges for each identified segment.
Run a published agent processor on a document.
Datalab serves its OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (info title "Datalab API") from its main domain
